_comment: Platform-churn indicators read from the SentinelOne activity log (GET /activities, activityTypes). 'destination' names the data field that carries the target console URL for migration events. Disabled indicators are kept in the sync so they can be turned on later without a backfill.

indicators.label: Move to another console commanded
indicators.note: A management user commanded the agent to move to another console. The target URL is the competitor indicator.

indicators.label: Moved to another console
indicators.note: The agent reported that it successfully moved to the target console.

indicators.label: Agent uninstalled
indicators.note: The agent was uninstalled from the device. SentinelOne cannot see what replaced it.

indicators.label: Uninstall command issued
indicators.note: A management user issued an uninstall command.

indicators.label: Agent decommissioned by user
indicators.note: A management user decommissioned the agent.

indicators.label: Agent auto-decommissioned
indicators.note: Offline longer than the auto-decommission period.

_vendors: Destination hosts are grouped by tenant slug (usea1-ninjaone2 and euce1-ninjaone are both 'ninjaone'). A vendor here names a known group: its first label and kind, and extra slugs ('match') that belong to it. Labels edited in the UI win over this list.
